question: Preeti walks 30 m towards the east from point P. She takes a left turn and walks 18 m. She takes a left turn again and walks 65 m. Again, she takes a left turn and walks 86 m. She takes a left turn again and walks 65 m. Again, she takes a left turn and walks 18 m. She takes one final left turn and walks 30 m to reach point Q. How far and in which direction is point Q from point P? (All turns are 90 degree turns only)
solution:
Given: 

Preeti walks 30 m towards the east from point P. 

Takes a left turn and walks 18 m. 

Takes a left turn again and walks 65 m. 

Again, takes a left turn and walks 86 m. 

Takes a left turn again and walks 65 m. 

Again, takes a left turn and walks 18 m. 

Takes one final left turn and walks 30 m to reach point Q. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c037156fa085b08205609716ea3692cba70a0ac8ef67c95dc33e8c172c1d8dfa.png] 

So, Q is '50 m in South' direction from point P.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
